_about: Public-domain William Henry Fitchett (1841-1928), Methodist minister and principal of the Methodist Ladies' College, Melbourne, for the Word Hoard: his religious books, The Unrealized Logic of Religion, Wesley and his Century, and The Beliefs of Unbelief. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 118 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

fitchett-unrealized-logic: The unrealized logic of religion : a study in credibilities (New York : Eaton & Mains, 1905)
fitchett-wesley: Wesley and his century : a study in spiritual forces (Toronto : W. Briggs, 1906)
fitchett-beliefs-unbelief: The beliefs of unbelief : studies in the alternatives to faith (New York : Eaton & Mains ; Cincinnati : Jennings & Graham, 1907)

_excluded.fitchett-history-fiction: His popular military histories (Deeds that Won the Empire, How England Saved Europe, Nelson, the Mutiny) and his novels are left to other lanes
